project.name: pulse-counter-web-app
project.summary: A curated stateful web miniature with an evidenced interaction loop.
project.thesis: User intent updates authoritative state and drives a rendered response through a controlled effect.

nodes.label: Increment Handler
nodes.description: Accepts the user increment intent and begins the documented update path.
nodes.why_it_matters: It identifies the visible interaction boundary.
nodes.inspector_summary: onIncrement initiates the documented interaction path.

nodes.label: State Reducer
nodes.description: Owns the count update produced from an explicit increment action.
nodes.why_it_matters: It distinguishes authoritative state ownership from presentation.
nodes.inspector_summary: reduceCounter applies the typed increment action.

nodes.label: Message Effect
nodes.description: Adds effect-backed message data after the count has changed.
nodes.inspector_summary: loadMessage is explicitly called after reduction.

nodes.label: Rendered Counter
nodes.description: Produces the output markup visible after the updated message is available.
nodes.inspector_summary: renderCounter displays the final documented state.

workflows.label: Increment And Render
workflows.description: Follow a documented UI action through state, effect, and rendered response.
